a.lede: Governments need to rein in increasingly capable AI agents before their risks are fully understood, a United Nations scientific panel warned in the global organization's first major assessment of OpenAI's hack of Hugging Face earlier this year. The report cements AI's place on the global diplomatic agenda this week as leaders gather in New York […]
a.title: UN says AI safeguards can’t wait for certainty

b.lede: Officials discussed setting up a mechanism for the two countries to notify each other of AI incidents which could threaten national security.
b.title: US and China Discuss Alerting Each Other to AI National Security Threats
